buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

1. The period of the Agreement by the Department with the Service Pro vider shall be 02 years from the date of the signing of this Agreement and subject to the fulfilment of terms and conditions of the tender an d which can be extended for further period of 01 year subject to the s atisfactory performance of the service and on the same terms and c onditions as contained in the bid document, with a service charge of 3.85%.The successful bidder is required to pay minimum wages to th e deployed staff at DC Rates of UT Chandigarh revised from time to ti me. 2. The Earned Money Deposit (EMD) may be fixed @ 3% of the estimate d value of the contract. 3. The Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) should be of the value of 3% of contract value with a validity of 60 days beyond the date of termin ation of contract. 4. The bid duration may be fixed for 21 days. 5. The validity of the bid may be fixed for 180 days. 6. 02 (Two) days’ time may be allowed to the bidder for technical clarifi cations. 7. The service charges for providing manpower outsourced services ma y be fixed @ 3.85% percent as minimum percentage prescribed on th e GeM portal. 8. Average turnover may be fixed 30% of the estimated value of the co ntract. 9.Experience of having successfully completed similar works in Central/ State Govt./PSU’s/Nationalized banks/Autonomous body during last 3 years ending last day of the month previous to the one in which the a pplications of tender are invited should be either of the following and joint ventures may not be accepted. a) Three orders each not less than the amount equal to 40% of the esti mated bid value. OR b) Two orders costing each not less than the amount equal to 50% of th e bid value. OR

c) One order costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the esti mated bid value. 10. The exemption to verified MSEs may be granted as per the rules. 11. The exemption to verified Startups may be granted as per the rules and the pre bid interaction may not be required. 12. The bidder should not be under liquidation, Court receivership or si milar proceedings and should not be bankrupt. 13. In case, the same percentage of service charges are quoted by the bidders, then the selection may be made through system using "Run L-1 Sel ection". 14. In case 20 or more Service Person are required to be engaged by th e Service Provider at the establishment of the department on any giv en day, such engagement shall be done by obtaining requisite Licen se under the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970 from the ‘Appropriate Authority. 15. Seeking any deposits or security amounts from the deployed resour ce or any other form of monetary acceptance by the service provider is strictly prohibited. If any such complaint is received, incident will b e raised on GeM portal for suitable action, against the Service Provide r, as per incident Management policy GeM. In addition, department m ay separately initiate suitable penal action and blacklist the Service P rovider as per the Blacklisting policy of UT Chandigarh Administration , ‘Policy on Blacklisting, 2009. 16. The Service Provider shall pay wages to the outsource employees b y the due date i.e. on or before 07 of every month and then raise a bil l for reimbursement with due evidence of salary and statutory dues p ayment. 17.The Service Provider/bidder should not have been blacklisted/prosec uted by any Center / State Government /Union Territories /Departme

nt /Offices /Statutory Bodies / Autonomous Organizations / Research I nstitution /any court of law. The Service Provider must furnish latest/ valid affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper duly attested by the Execu tive Magistrate /Notary regarding non-blacklisting /non prosecution of the Service Provider as per Performa given below: Affidavit I/We (Name) Service Provider /partner /sole proprietor (strike out wh ich is not applicable) of (firm) do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the individual / firm / company is not blacklisted /prosecuted by any Centr al /State Govt. /Union Territories / Departments/Officers/Statutory Bodies/ Autonomous Organizations/Research Institutions /any court of law. Place DEPONENT Date VERIFICATION Verified that the contents of above affidavit is true and correct to t he best of my/our knowledge and belief. No part of it is false and nothing has been kept concealed there from place Deponent date, (Affidavit not one month old from date of bid). Place DEPONENT Date 18. In case of any violation of any terms & condition of contract, the Servic e Provider is liable to be blacklisted as per Blacklisting policy of UT Cha ndigarh Administration, Policy on Blacklisting, 2009 dated the 27th Febr uary, 2009. 19. Any short payment and/or non-payment of wages/salary statutory cont ributions in respect of service persons during the course of the contract shall be made good by the Service Provider within 07 days of written no tice by the Department, failing which the Department reserves its right to deduct any such amount equivalent to such short payment from the payables to the agency or Security Deposit and may cancel the contrac t, blacklist the Service Provider etc. 20.The Service Provider shall keep the Department indemnified against all penalties, claims and liabilities arising out of applicability and/or violatio n of such Act, laws or Regulations etc. 21. If at any time during the period of the contract, it is observed by the D epartment that the services rendered by the Service Provider are not to the satisfaction of the Department or any terms of the contract are violated, the Department will issue one written notice for rectifying the

default in 5 working days and thereafter if the default is not rectified th e Department will immediately terminate the contract with immediate effect without any further notice or compensation thereof and shall blac klist the Service Provider as per Blacklisting Policy of UT Chandigarh Ad ministration, Policy on Blacklisting, 2009 dated the 27th February, 2009 . 22. Any amount due and recoverable from the Service Provider on account on salary/wages (minimum wage, insurance, PF, ESI etc.) and taxes, will be recoverable as arrears of land revenue. 23. In case any situation arises, where re-allotment of a contract is requ ired, the re-allotment will be done at the risk and cost of original allo ttee. In case of any deficiency, the balance / deficient amount will be recoverable from the original allottee as arrears of land revenue. 24. If the Service Provider fails / delays in performance of any of the obli gations under the Contract /violates any of the provisions of the Cont ract/ commits breach of any of the terms and conditions of the Depa rtment may at anytime, without prejudice to any other right of actio n/ remedy, may blacklist the Service provider under the Blacklisting policy of UT Chandigarh Administration, Policy on Blacklisting, 2009 dated the 27th February 2009. 25. The Service Provider/bidder should not be under liquidation, court re ceivership or similar proceedings should not be bankrupt. Service Pr ovider/Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid (i.e. not m ore than one month old from the date of publication of tender). 26. In case of any contradiction between the GEM inbuilt terms and the Ad ditional Terms, the Additional Terms shall prevail. 27. The Bidder GST Risk Rating should be Low/Medium. 28.All disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Chandigarh. 29.Deployment of Existing working/deployed resources (Manpower). Num ber of existing working/deployed resources of the procurement depart ment having job satisfactory certificate will be continued by the succe ssful service provider under the new contract concluded on the basis o f this bid. Provided the existing manpower satisfies Educational Qualifi cation.. 30. The Experience certificate should also be got emailed from the concer ned Central/State Govt./PSU’s/Nationalized banks/Autonomous body of ficial email id and no email id like Gmail, Yahoo etc. would be consider

ed for experience certificate while considering the uploaded document s also. 31. The Service Provider/Bidder Head Office address must be registered within Chandigarh, Panchkula or SAS Nagar (Tricity) and having GSTN Number. The Service Provider/Bidder whose office is not located in Ge ographical area of tricity shall not be allowed to participate in the Bid and bid shall be straight away rejected. Documentary Evidence of add ress shall be (i) anyone of the Electricity Bill, Water or MC Tax bill clear ly mentioning the address (in the name of the service provider/Landlor d) or PAN No &GSTNo. clearly mentioning the address (in the name of t he service provider); alongwith (ii) registered Proprietorship/ registere d Rent Agreement in the name of the Service Provider /Bidder clearly mentioning the address to be submitted as proof. Registered Rent Agr eement alone will not be considered as a valid proof. .
